summary.content:
Today's selection covers 104 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 15 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Barret Zoph is out at OpenAI again after just five months
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: ‘Popa’ Botnet Linked to Publicly-Traded Israeli Firm
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from Krebs on Security, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 56 articles published in the last 24 hours
